coreMemory.english: v. to own, contain, or possess something；v. to experience a condition, event, or problem；v. used with to to express necessity or obligation；v. to take part in, receive, eat, or drink something
coreMemory.structure: have enough time /ˈhæv ɪˈnʌf ˈtaɪm/（有足够时间）；have a problem with something /ˈhæv ə ˈprɑbləm ˈwɪð ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（在某事上遇到问题）；have to do something /ˈhæv ˈtuː ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（必须做某事）；have something in common /ˈhæv ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪn ˈkɑmən/（有共同点）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ have doing something → ✅ have to do something；❌ have a chance doing something → ✅ have a chance to do something

commonErrors.note: 这个结构要用 have + to + 动词原形；do 只是词卡里的动词占位符，真实句子要换成 finish、check 等具体动词。

commonErrors.right: have a chance to do something
commonErrors.note: 这个结构要用 have + to + 动词原形；do 只是词卡里的动词占位符，真实句子要换成 finish、check 等具体动词。

meanings.english: to own, contain, or possess something
meanings.example: I have enough time to review five words tonight.
meanings.translation: 我今晚有足够时间复习五个单词。

meanings.english: to experience a condition, event, or problem
meanings.example: If you have a problem with the assignment, ask the teacher.
meanings.translation: 如果你在作业上遇到问题，请问老师。

meanings.english: used with to to express necessity or obligation
meanings.example: I have to finish this report before noon.
meanings.translation: 我必须在中午前完成这份报告。

meanings.english: to take part in, receive, eat, or drink something
meanings.example: We had lunch together after the lesson.
meanings.translation: 下课后我们一起吃了午饭。

synonyms.difference: possess 侧重“拥有；具有”。对应的常用英文义是 “to own, contain, experience, or take part in something”。have 在本卡搭配“have enough time”中表达“有”；换词时要同时检查宾语和介词。

antonyms.usage: 在“有”这个义项下，lack（缺少；没有）与 have 形成对比。对应的常用英文义是 “opposite of have”。只在这个明确义项和句型中对比，不把两个词的所有用法都视为相反。

confusables.difference: there is 表示“有；存在”；have 在本卡核心搭配“have enough time”中表示“有”。答题时要根据句意和完整结构区分，不只看拼写或中文近义。
